notes: AXON's 10-K (FY2023) and Q2-2024 10-Q narrative is dominated by state/local law enforcement (TASER, Axon body cameras, Evidence.com SaaS). DoD/Pentagon exposure is aspirational and unstructured: no named Program Elements (PEs), no named DoD programs (Skyborg/CCA/Project Maven/etc.), no quantified DoD program revenue. Closest DoD-adjacent vectors are: (a) general 'U.S. military' customer-base-expansion language, (b) the pending Dedrone acquisition (counter-UAS / airspace security) which has DoD-adjacent applications, (c) Sky-Hero (indoor tactical drones, competes with Brinc/XTEND), (d) 'federal agencies' as a customer category with no PE-tied dollar figures. This is essentially a state/local-government revenue story with DoD-adjacency as a future option. Per the J-Book heuristic, claims naming SPECIFIC PEs simply do not exist; pentagon_jbook is structurally not the primary verifier for AXON's core thesis. Most J-Book-grounded probes will return NOT_FOUND -> UNVERIFIABLE; that is the correct framework answer, not a defect.
